biography: Dawie van der Merwe hails from the dusty karting tracks of Soweto, South Africa, a world away from the polished circuits of European motorsport. Growing up, Dawie's father, a mechanic, instilled in him a deep understanding of racing machinery. His breakthrough came at age 16 when he won the Gauteng Junior Karting Championship against wealthier, better-equipped competitors. This victory earned him a scholarship to a regional racing academy. After struggling to adapt to formula racing he found his calling in saloon car racing, becoming a firm favorite with VW due to his ability to push the Polo GTS to its absolute limit. He is currently seen as a rising star in the South African motorsport scene, with many pundits predicting a move to international touring car racing if he can secure further victories in the national VW Polo Cup.
drivingStyle: Dawie's driving style is defined by its clinical precision and calculated risk-taking. He is known for his late-braking maneuvers and uncanny ability to conserve tires, often leaving his rivals struggling for grip in the closing laps. Dawie rarely makes rash moves, instead patiently analyzing his opponents' weaknesses and exploiting them with surgical accuracy. He excels under pressure, displaying a remarkable calmness that allows him to make split-second decisions with ice-cold clarity.

careerHighlight: Winning the 2022 VW Polo Cup race at Kyalami after starting from the back of the grid due to a mechanical issue in qualifying, displaying incredible overtaking skills.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the 2023 championship decider, costing him the overall title.
